questions.stem_text:
The volume of plasma and other extracellular fluids are regulated by automatic feedback
controls. What are these controls?

options.A: The controls are nerve impulses in the body
options.B: The controls are the contraction and relaxation cycles of skeletal muscles
options.C: The controls are hormonal responses that regulate digestion and absorption of food
options.D: The controls are mechanisms that regulate the heart rate
options.E: The controls are processes that control the body temperature

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The controls are nerve impulses in the body

Based on the characteristic population curves that result from plotting population growth
of a species, the most effective means of controlling the mosquito population is to

options.A: opt for zero population control once the K value of the curve has been reached
options.B: maintain the population at the highest point of its logistic curve
options.C: reduce the carrying capacity cif the environment to lower the K value
options.E: increase the birth rate of the species

questions.stem_text: Two related species evolve in a way that makes them less similar.
Is there still a need for living-related liver transplantation in children?
questions.answer_explanation: The short- and long-term outcomes after LRT and SLT did not differ significantly. To avoid the risk for the donor in LRT, SLT represents the first-line therapy in pediatric liver transplantation in countries where cadaveric organs are available. LRT provides a solution for urgent cases in which a cadaveric graft cannot be found in time or if the choice of the optimal time point for transplantation is vital.

questions.stem_text: Should displaced midshaft clavicular fractures be treated surgically?
questions.answer_explanation: The available evidence suggests that the operative treatment for DMCF is associated with a lower rate of nonunion, malunion and complication than nonoperative treatment. This study supports traditional primary operative treatment for DMCF in active adults.

questions.stem_text: The colour of pain: can patients use colour to describe osteoarthritis pain?
questions.answer_explanation: For some patients, using colour to describe their pain experience may be a useful tool to improve doctor-patient communication.

questions.stem_text: Does elective re-siting of intravenous cannulae decrease peripheral thrombophlebitis?
questions.answer_explanation: Elective re-siting of intravenous cannulae every 48 hours results in a significant reduction in the incidence and severity of PVT. We recommend that this should be adopted as standard practice in managing all patients who require prolonged intravenous therapy.

questions.stem_text: Do Wound Cultures Give Information About the Microbiology of Blood Cultures in Severe Burn Patients?
questions.answer_explanation: When there is clinical suspicion of sepsis, appropriate empirical systemic antibiotic therapy should be broad spectrum and should rely on the susceptibility of the organisms from recent cultures of the burn wound surface, until the blood cultures results are completed.
